exercises.name: Swimming

source_english.description: Swimming is a prone alternating arm-and-leg pattern that mimics a gentle swim stroke for continuous cardio.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift the right arm with the left leg while the opposite pair stays long.
Switch sides in a steady alternating rhythm without lifting the ribs high.
Continue for the planned interval, then lower the limbs.
source_english.safety_note: Use a small range and stop if the lower back cannot stay relaxed.

exercises.name: Thruster (Barbell)

source_english.description: Thruster (Barbell) combines a front-rack barbell squat with an immediate overhead press.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in the front-rack position.
Squat by bending the hips and knees while keeping the chest lifted.
Drive through the feet to stand and use the same momentum to press the load overhead.
Lower the load to the shoulders, then descend into the next squat.
form_cues: Finish the leg drive before pressing.
common_mistakes: Dropping the load to the shoulders.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load you can lower safely to the shoulders after every press.

source_english.description: Thruster (Kettlebell) combines a squat holding one kettlebell at the chest with an overhead press.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold one kettlebell at the chest.
Squat by bending the hips and knees while keeping the chest lifted.
Drive through the feet to stand and use the same momentum to press the load overhead.
Lower the load to the shoulders, then descend into the next squat.
form_cues: Finish the leg drive before pressing.
common_mistakes: Dropping the load to the shoulders.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load you can lower safely to the shoulders after every press.

exercises.name: Wall Ball

source_english.description: Wall Ball squats with a medicine ball at the chest and throws it vertically to a wall target.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the medicine ball at the chest.
Squat until the thighs approach parallel while keeping heels down.
Drive through the legs and release the ball upward toward the wall target.
Catch it at chest height, absorb the catch, and descend into the next squat.
form_cues: Keep the ball close before the throw.
common_mistakes: Standing too close to the wall.
source_english.safety_note: Use a wall and ball rated for impacts and keep the catch zone clear.

Finish with relaxed movement before starting the main session.
